info.title: statuscake-mcp — StatusCake uptime monitoring from the command line.
info.description: A minimal, token-efficient StatusCake uptime monitoring tool — a command-line client by default, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (stdio or Streamable HTTP) under the `mcp` subcommand.

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Detail for one check (status, uptime %, last tested).
history <id> [--limit N]
Recent up/down periods for one check (default 10).
ssl [--days N] [--page N] [--limit N]
SSL certificates expiring within N days (default 30).

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run as an MCP server (stdio, or Streamable HTTP).

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Pause one check so it stops testing and alerting.
